description: This file declares functions related to object ID handling, including parsing hex strings into object IDs and setting up hash algorithms, primarily for use in Git or similar version control systems.

methods.name: cl_parse_any_oid
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into an object_id structure, handling different hash algorithms based on environment variables.

methods.name: cl_setup_hash_algo
methods.description: Sets up the hashing algorithm (SHA-1, SHA-256, etc.) based on environment variables and validates the selection.
